items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Because I don't know what Brooks is going to play, but I'm looking right at him. I don't know what Procope going to play, until I hear him

ctx.x: You noticed down at Gregory's very seldom I used -- very seldom you see me pick up the stick and come on out loud, brushes. Because I do the same thing with a brush, more I think, than I can with a drumstick.

Because I don't know what Brooks is going to play, but I'm looking right at him. I don't know what Procope going to play, until I hear him, so I place things that will come around and say, fill out and sound good A lot of guys would, 'How you do that?' favorite saying: I say, 'Man, I'm crazy.' Bubber Miley's -- 'How you doing, Bubber?' 'Man, I'm crazy, I don't know.' Bechet say, 'I'm crazy', that's all they ever say. Crazy like a fox. One of them things. Good times.
I was going to ask you -- let's just go to the end. So the only training that you had as a drummer was the training that you got from this drummer that you heard in the show named Peggy?
